extracted.intended_audience: Interested persons and stakeholders submitting comments on FAA and EPA proposed rules (aviation stakeholders, agricultural producers, pesticide manufacturers, and other members of the public)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting public comments on federal notice-and-comment rulemakings (examples here include FAA airspace amendments and EPA pesticide tolerance actions). Covers what to include in comments, how to file, deadlines, and special procedures for Confidential Business Information (CBI).

rubrics_metrics.name: Helpfulness criteria for comments
rubrics_metrics.description: The most helpful comments reference a specific portion of the proposal, explain the reason for any recommended change, and include supporting data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When possible, tie your comment to a particular paragraph, figure, map, or legal provision in the proposal; explain why you recommend a change (safety, operational, economic, environmental reasons); and attach or cite supporting data, analyses, or references to bolster your position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid duplicate submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure the docket does not contain duplicate comments, commenters should submit only one time if comments are filed electronically, or commenters should send only one copy of written comments if comments are filed in writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a single comment per docket (choose either the electronic filing or a single paper copy). Multiple identical submissions can clutter the docket and are discouraged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Observe comment deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received on or before the date specified in the notice (example dates in this document include July 7, 2025; June 23, 2025; July 21, 2025 depending on the docket).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File comments so they are received by the stated closing date; late comments may be considered only if possible without incurring expense or delay. Check the docket-specific 'DATES' line for the exact deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify the docket and agency identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by the docket identification number(s) shown in the notice (e.g., 'FAA Docket No. FAA—2025-0946 and Airspace Docket No. 25—ASO-11' or 'EPA—HQ—OPP-2025—0153').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the docket ID(s) on your submission so your comment is placed in the correct rulemaking file. Use the exact identifiers shown in the Federal Register notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted methods and addresses for filing comments
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice lists acceptable methods for submitting comments: Federal eRulemaking Portal (www.regulations.gov), mail, hand delivery/courier, and fax, with specific addresses and room numbers for physical delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the listed submission route(s) for the specific docket. For mail/hand delivery, use the physical address and room number in the notice; for electronic filing, follow the instructions at regulations.gov. The notice provides contact points and phone numbers for Docket Operations and agency offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope/topics the agency is specifically inviting comment on
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency invites comments on the overall regulatory, aeronautical, economic, environmental, and energy-related aspects of the proposal (FAA), and on the tolerance actions described (EPA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When commenting, address the aspects the agency calls out (for FAA: regulatory, aeronautical, economic, environmental, energy-related; for EPA: the specific tolerance changes such as revising tolerance expressions, modifying commodity definitions, updating crop groupings, removing expired tolerances, revoking tolerances, and harmonizing with Codex). Explicitly explain impacts in those domains and provide data where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy/public posting notice
rubrics_metrics.description: DOT (and the agencies) posts submitted comments, without edits, including any personal information the commenter provides, to www.regulations.gov as described in the system of records notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that comments will generally be publicly posted and may include personal identifiers you include. If you do not want personal information posted, do not include it in your comment (see CBI rules for sensitive information).

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential Business Information (CBI) submission rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not submit CBI to EPA through email or https://www.regulations.gov. If you wish to include CBI in your comment, follow the applicable instructions at the agency's docket/CBI instructions and clearly mark the information you claim to be CBI. Information so marked will not be disclosed except in accordance with procedures set forth in 40 CFR part 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the agency-prescribed procedures for submitting CBI (often a separate, clearly marked submission and follow-up). Never put CBI into the public comment that will be posted on regulations.gov; instead follow the notice's specific CBI submission instructions and mark CBI claims clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tips for preparing comments (agency guidance links)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice points commenters to agency-specific tips for preparing comments (for EPA: https://www.epa.gov/dockets/commenting-epa-dockets and commenting tips link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the provided 'tips for preparing your comments' links for practical guidance (formatting, how to reference docket material, how to submit supporting information). Use those tips to make comments clear, substantive, and properly formatted for docketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process when a commenter requests retention of a tolerance (EPA-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you want the Agency to maintain a tolerance that the Agency proposes to revoke, this proposed rule provides a 60-day public comment period to state an interest in retaining a tolerance; if EPA receives such a comment within the 60-day period, EPA will not proceed to revoke the tolerance immediately and will take steps to ensure submission of any needed supporting data and may issue an order under FFDCA section 408(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To preserve a tolerance under consideration for revocation, timely state your interest in retaining it and be prepared to submit supporting data. If you fail to provide required data after EPA's order, EPA may proceed to revoke. After a final rule, you may file objections or request a hearing within the timeframe specified in the final rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket access and review of background materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents, prior notices, and comments received may be read at www.regulations.gov at any time or inspected in person at the Docket Operations office (address and hours provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before preparing your comment, review the docket to see existing comments, background documents, and referenced materials so your submission can reference or build on those documents and avoid repetition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide specific technical/operational detail for aviation proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: For airspace and RNAV route proposals, comments that identify specific technical issues (coordinates, bearings, radii, waypoint fixes, operational impacts) and explain aeronautical effects are relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When commenting on FAA airspace or route amendments, reference specific legal descriptions, coordinates, bearings, and procedural impacts (e.g., effect on IFR procedures, charted supplements). Supply aeronautical data, safety analyses, or operational experience where applicable.
